title: Nvidia's New Humanoid Robot: 3 Things to Know
description:
Nvidia and Germany's Agile Robots just unveiled the Agile ONE SN, a 1.4 m reference humanoid for robot labs, at GTC Berlin on Oct 21.
It has touch-sensing 20-degree-of-freedom hands and comes with Nvidia's GR00T robot AI and a Jetson Thor computer. It's due in early 2027.
